args.lesson: This narrows the scope of L82; it does not reverse it. Thread 683136 is a vendor's survey, so it is still not a request for the existing transformer. However, 20 of its 64 posts include at least 5 participants who describe comparing supplier and Shopify CSVs by hand in Excel. One of them says a USD 19 one-time price could be reasonable and that they prefer a browser tool. That is problem-level evidence for a different job: comparing two files. Stated intent is not a purchase, and a free competitor reportedly exists. Lesson: a survey thread can reject one product and still give evidence for another job, so read the replies before treating a thread as not qualifying. Keep the build bounded and make it a concrete package for founder option B. Stop on parity failure or a NEEDS_WORK verdict.
